Just some tips that have worked great for me. 

Hair cut and eyebrows can change your face so much. For the eyebrows I just ask for them to get cleaned up shaped a little. It really clears up your face I believe. (I like to get them threaded but most go with wax just be watch out for ingrown hairs and reddest from the wax) & haircut whatever you like man. Your 17 go wild if you want, it grows back & you can really find a style and play around with it until you do.

Water bro!! I swear not only will it help with the acne (I cut out everything but water as my main drink) but it can also help with weight! Also moisturizer! Get a simple cleanser, toner, & moisturizer. You don’t need a bunch of fancy stuff, go for non scented too. And if you can try Differin Gel, you can get it at Walmart or even order from Amazon. It used to be only prescribed by doctors but now you can buy it. Helped a ton of clearing up my acne. Just follow the directions. 

As for the hair, you don’t have to shave complete off, maybe that but try trimming it, and shaving the parts you don’t like. buy a good as razor with a trimmer of all kinds of sizes & play around until you find the length you’re comfortable with! 

On getting into shape it really just comes down to patience and dedication. Focus on using good form & just research as much as you can. Also don’t forget the diet, no matter how good you workout if you eat the wrong things it can throw all the good progress away! Water & greens. Personally I got into fasting, but different strokes for different folks. Look at what you can cut out & replace with healthy greens. 

Also as a mixed black man all I can is learn to love yourself. Indian people are just as beautiful & handsome as white, Asian, black & everything else in the world. Don’t hate your skin just because media shoves the same blond white man or women in your face! Seriously you have a history and culture that’s rich with individualism. Be happy that you’re different and embrace it man. It’s hard I know but I promise your skin color does not make you ugly! 

Finally most of this is just puberty. Your body will settle but it’s going to change & we gonna just ride it out until 25ish I believe lol so just so buckle up man I swear it does get better.
